﴿By time﴾: the age, or the period from the sun's decline after midday (al-zawal) until sunset, or the afternoon prayer (ṣalāt al-ʿaṣr).
﴿Indeed, mankind﴾ [i.e., the human species] ﴿is surely in loss﴾ [in their trade/dealings].

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 103, verse 3:

﴿Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds﴾, and they are not in loss. ﴿And advise one another﴾, they urge one another ﴿to truth﴾, which is faith, ﴿and advise one another to patience﴾, upon obedience and away from disobedience.
